name: Blue Professional
description: Cream paper background with a single electric cobalt accent, soft tinted cards, and consulting-style report rhythm.

font_strategy.cjk_display: Noto Sans SC or Microsoft YaHei
font_strategy.cjk_body: Noto Serif SC or Microsoft YaHei

readability_scale.target: classroom projection readable at approximately 3 meters

render_strategy.notes: Each slide uses a high-fidelity PNG rendered from the HTML template as the background, with editable text boxes overlaid from DOM text-node coordinates. Overlay text is transparent to avoid double-rendering over the screenshot background. The build script applies a PPT readability override to enlarge body, chart, card, and detail text compared with the source HTML.

rescue_notes: Rebuilt as an HTML-background hybrid master. This preserves the original HTML visual design while adding editable text boxes above the rendered background. Frontend and Writer consume visual_master=blue_professional.
